t: Over 2000 known uses. Cleans, protects, displaces moisture, penetrates, lubricates, gets under dirt and grease, dissolves adhesives, dries electrical systems and eliminates moisture-induced short circuits. Loosens rusted, frozen or stuck metal fastenings, holds firmly to all moving parts, corrosion resistant, shields against moisture on bare metal. It will not affect fabrics, rubbers or plastics.
